evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Verify Aider prompt delivery, SEARCH/REPLACE file editing, shell/repository access and safe-output publication.
intent.acceptance: The host checker independently verifies exact expected file content and a successful native shell tool event whose command matches git-log syntax and whose output contains a commit-shaped line. Full acceptance additionally requires independently proven SEARCH/REPLACE editing, readback and correct event-specific safe-output publication, not an agent PASS claim.

evidence.opportunity: Named source-defined behavioral assertions per independently observed execution attempt.
filters: Only exact reviewed host checker scripts and protected environments establish behavioral proof.
Run, agent and job success are never behavioral evidence. A failed conjunction has unknown components.
Distinct attempts are repeated monitoring assessments, not unique repository improvements.
Observed native subtotals survive missing attempts; they are not complete workflow-wide totals.
Aider's checker proves two partial facets, not edit method or safe-output publication.
Agy requires its actual specialized native gate separately from the shared conformance gate.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked replay of bounded immutable-head Actions receipts, reviewed source blobs and trusted mainline lock/runtime trees.

model.architecture: Source-specific independent host assertions, preserving unknown cases and full acceptance separately.
model.recommendation: No native keep bar was agreed; not rated. Missing evidence is not failed behavior.

metrics.name: Observed independently proven behaviors
metrics.formula: Count named source-defined host behavioral assertions proven true; unknown components stay unknown.

metrics.name: Fully accepted smoke assessments
metrics.formula: Count assessments meeting every source-specific goal requirement, only when all acceptance facts are known.
